報價圖面處理系統 — PDF integration source and third-party notices

The browser receives the application source directly (no minification/build step):
  index.html, app.js, style.css, pdf-workspace.js, pdf-worker.js, pdf-engine.js,
  ai-settings.js, glossary.js, glossary-data.js.
A copy of this site's source and assets is available at source.zip.

MuPDF JavaScript / WASM 1.27.0
Copyright (C) 2004-2025 Artifex Software, Inc.
Distributed without modifications under GNU Affero General Public License v3
or later. Full terms: vendor/mupdf/LICENSE.
Upstream corresponding source, build instructions and licensing:
  https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/mupdf.js
  https://mupdf.com/licensing/
The browser binding and WASM are the published mupdf@1.27.0 npm distribution.
Commercial/closed-source distribution requires review of applicable licensing
and, where appropriate, a commercial license from Artifex.

JSZip
Copyright Stuart Knightley, David Duponchel, Franz Buchinger, Antonio Afonso.
Distributed under MIT; see vendor/JSZip-LICENSE.

PDF processing occurs in a local browser worker. Source PDFs are stored in
IndexedDB, and case metadata remains in this browser's local storage. No AI
recognition or cloud PDF upload is enabled by this integration.

React / React DOM, Ant Design, Ant Design Icons, Day.js
Bundled from pinned npm versions (see package.json and package-lock.json).
Complete dependency license texts: THIRD_PARTY_UI_LICENSES.txt.
Bundled source notices are also preserved in antd-ui.js.
UI source: src/ui; build: scripts/build-ui.mjs; bridge: ui-adapter.js.
